contexts.text: That the Lord interceded... afterwards, for those with whom there are states of the affection of good from any other source, who are signified by twenty (). Treated of.
Peradventure twenty shall be found there () = if there be not anything of combat, but still there be good.

Twenty, being twice ten, = remains, that is, good, in a higher degree... The good of ignorance exists from man's tenth to his twentieth year; and from this year he begins to become rational... Thus the good of ignorance is signified by twenty, for those in it do not come into any temptation... and those who are not in temptations, and yet have good, are here treated of. As by twenty are signified those who have this good, all those who went out from Egypt were numbered from twenty years old and upwards... and all those who were above twenty years died in the wilderness (,  and ), because evil could be imputed to them; and they represented those who succumb in temptations. Further illustrated and ex.
Twenty, or twice ten, = what is full... And the fulness of the states of the Church means their end.
The reason it is so often said that the shekel is twenty gerahs... is that (this expression) = the estimation of the good of remains; for twenty = the good of remains.

These twenty years have I been with thee () = what was His Own; for twenty = the good of remains; and remains, when predicated of the Lord, are that which is his Own. Twenty years = the states of this. AC 4176.

For twenty pieces of silver () = estimation; for twenty = the good and truth which are stored up by the Lord in the interior man, which are called remains; and thus holy good or truth; here, holy truth, because silver is mentioned. The same number also = what is not holy... relatively to those who sold Joseph; but it = what is holy relatively to those who bought him.
The reason twenty = also what is not holy, is that twenty = remains; and with those who have no remains... what is holy is not holy, but... is either filthy or profane. Illustrated.
In these passages, twenty = what is unholy, unclean, and profane.

Twenty boards for the habitation () = the good which supports Heaven in every way and completely... Twenty = what is full, thus in every way and completely... For twenty = the same as 10, and 2, from which it arises as multiplication; and 10 = what is full, and all; as also does 2. AC 9644.
The twenty pillars thereof () = the goods of truth which fully support... For twenty = fully. AC 9752.
Their twenty bases of brass () = the truths, from good which also fully support... Twenty = fully.
Twenty cubits () = to the full; for twenty = what is full.

Twenty oboli a shekel () = all things of good; for twenty = all things; also the remains of good, and also what is holy. References. For twenty, when predicated of the Lord, = what is His. Own, which is what is holy itself; from which it is evident why the shekel was of twenty gerahs or oboli; and why it is called the shekel of holiness.

From a son of twenty years and upwards () = a state of intelligence in truth and in good; for (this is the signification of) twenty when predicated of man's age. The reason twenty (has this signification) is that when man attains twenty years, he begins to think from himself. (Continued. See Age.)

A son of twenty years and upwards () = those who are in a state of intelligence; for with these the truths and goods of faith and love can be ordinated and disposed by the Lord. Explained... And therefore it is said from a son of twenty years and upwards everyone that goeth forth into the army... AC 10225:10. AC 10225:11.
At this day no Spirits stay in the World of Spirits longer than twenty years.

The flying roll was twenty cubits iit length, and ten in breadth (), because twenty, and ten = all; here, all good changed into evil, and all truth into falsity; for twenty is predicated of good, and of all of it; and ten, of truth and of all of it.
